text:
Aisha (Docs): Drafting relnotes for tomorrow's docs deploy (v1.6.0). Main items: snippet path cleanup, one 404 from embed-api anchor changes, and a streaming quirk QA found. Opening PR shortly.

Ben (SDK): can you list the failing snippet refs so I can grep the examples?

Aisha (Docs): two hits: `snippet:embed-legacy` in guides/embeddings/quickstart.md and `snippet:chat-step-3` in tutorials/chat/flow.md (anchor renamed). Will add exact paths in the PR body.

Cara (I18N): our locales (fr/ja) still reference the old anchors. I'll wait for final anchor name to avoid rebase churn.

QA-Bot: New issue #9021  embed streaming may drop final token for very short prompts on canary. Repro attached.

Ethan (Eng): confirmed. It's a flush-ordering corner-case on canary for max_tokens <= 7. Patch planned for next micro release. Recommend Known Issue + workaround.

Marco (Docs): suggested wording: "Known issue: short streaming sequences on canary models may omit the final token. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use stable models." Add repro snippet and support triage steps.

Ben (SDK): I'll push a tiny PR adding TODO stub snippets so snippet-check passes while canonical fixes land.

Aisha (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7890  title: "Relnotes v1.6.0: snippet tidy, anchor redirect, streaming note". Draft includes 3 bullets, one-line repro, localization anchor `#known-issues-v1-6-0`.

QA-Bot: CI for #7890  docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 unresolved refs), link-check: fail (1 404).

Ben (SDK): stub PR #7891 merged with TODO snippets. Re-running checks.

QA-Bot: All checks passing on #7890 after stubs merged.

Cara (I18N): I'll rebase the locale branches and open the i18n PR once the anchor is live.

Ethan (Eng): if QA needs a short staging canary to validate the repro, ping me and I'll spin one up for 20m.

Aisha (Docs): added rollback contact `#eng-oncall` and a one-line rollback playbook to the relnotes. Planning to merge tomorrow 09:30 PT and post announce after deploy.

Marco (Docs): LGTM from docs. Leave small copy comments on the PR if needed.

Ben (SDK): nits left on PR; otherwise good.

Aisha (Docs): merging in 10 unless objections. Thanks all! :tada:
